read.thesis: Q1 CY26 earnings release shows solid credit and pre-provision earnings up 8% to $6.8B, but card loans shrank 3% and NIM fell 39bp; no supply-side or capacity signals, read is neutral-to-soft.

triggers.label: Card loans down 3% q/q
triggers.quote: Credit Card period-end loans decreased $9.0 billion, or 3 percent, to $270.6 billion.

triggers.label: NIM down 39bp to 7.87%
triggers.quote: Net interest margin of 7.87 percent, a decrease of 39 basis points.

triggers.label: Pre-provision earnings up 8%
triggers.quote: Pre-provision earnings increased 8 percent to $6.8 billion.
